title: The Oldest City You've Never Visited: Diyarbakir, Turkiye
rawDescription:
Love discovering new places? 🌍
Explore Türkiye through my films, travel guides, and hidden gems.
https://showmeturkiye.com
─ Diyarbakir is a walled city of black basalt above the Tigris River, and one of the oldest continuously inhabited places on earth. In this travel vlog, we explore the historic Sur district, the 11th-century Ulu Camii (Great Mosque), the unique acoustics of Deve Hamami, and the iconic On Gozlu Bridge. We also dive into the rich Southeastern Anatolian cuisine, tasting traditional liver kebabs, and the famous Burma Kadayif.

📍 For the complete map locations, historical details, and a full Diyarbakir travel guide, visit the website I built for travelling Turkiye: https://showmeturkiye.com/cities/diyarbakir

Let me know in the comments below if you would visit Diyarbakir & why?

title: Hakkari: The Hidden Gem of Turkiye - Let Me Show You Turkiye
rawDescription:
Love discovering new places? 🌍
Explore Türkiye through my films, travel guides, and hidden gems.
https://showmeturkiye.com
─ Hakkari is probably the most underrated corner of Türkiye. 20,000 year old glaciers, plateaus at 3,500 meters, and the kind of warmth from locals you don't forget.

Full Hakkari travel guide, where to go, what to eat, what to actually do:
👉 https://showmeturkiye.com/cities/hakkari

In this vlog we hike the Cilo Mountains and the ancient glaciers that survived the ice age, follow the road through Kaval Valley to its waterfall, cross the Zap River, and climb up to Bercelan Plateau for one of the most overlooked views in the country. We also stop for keledoş (lamb, yogurt, spices) and patlıcan dolması, and even end up at a local wedding.

If you're looking for a part of Türkiye where almost no tourist has set foot yet, this is it.

Explore more cities and routes across Turkiye:
🌍 https://showmeturkiye.com

Local guide who made this possible: @emin.noyan

title: Show Me Turkiye - Afyon | A cinematic travel series of Turkiye
rawDescription:
Thermal springs, dramatic rock formations, and one of the most underrated food cities in Türkiye. This is Show Me Afyonkarahisar.

Full Afyonkarahisar travel guide, where to go, what to eat, what to do:
👉 https://showmeturkiye.com/cities/afyonkarahisar

I've been working on this video for almost a month. Show Me Turkiye is an idea, not a video, and the whole point is to show Türkiye to the world the way it deserves to be seen. These lands are not just a couple of beaches and balloons (those are great too, but there's so much more). The better we tell our own story, the better we get understood.

Follow the project on Instagram:
